title: Universal counit square for ordinary scalar balancing
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\varphi:A\to B$ a homomorphism of finite commutative rings. Use the ordinary uncompleted pro-etale module categories and exact constant-ring inverse images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $E_Z$ and $T_Z$ be ordinary and derived extension along $\varphi_Z$, $r_Z$ restriction, and $e_Z:r_ZE_Z\simeq(-)\otimes_{A_Z}B_Z$ the uniquely pure-tensor-normalized ordinary identification [def-sp-proetale-scalar-mate-identifications, det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]. Let $b:r_Xf_B^*\simeq f_A^*r_Y$ be the specified derived restriction comparison and $\theta:f_B^*T_Y\simeq T_Xf_A^*$ the inverse scalar mate [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction, def-sp-constant-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Let $t:f_A^*((-)\otimes B_Y)\simeq(f_A^*(-))\otimes B_X$ be any natural ordinary tensor isomorphism with the unit-section formula of [lem-sp-proetale-scalar-balancing-chain]. For every cochain complex $P$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], define $c_{t,P}:f_A^*r_YE_YP\simeq r_XE_Xf_A^*P$ by applying $f_A^*e_Y$, then $t$, then $e_X^{-1}$ in each degree. This is an actual chain isomorphism, constructed degreewise, without any derived choice. Write $d_Z(P)=r_Z(\varepsilon_Z(P))$ followed by the exact restriction localization factor, where $\varepsilon_Z$ is the universal scalar cochain counit, and write $\lambda_C$ for the exact pullback localization factor [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Then
$$f_A^*(d_Y(P));\lambda_{r_YE_YP};Q(c_{t,P})=b^{-1}_{T_YQP};r_X(\theta_{QP};T_X(\lambda_P);\varepsilon_X(f_A^*P));\lambda^{r_X}_{E_Xf_A^*P}.$$
The notation $;$ means composition in the order written. No K-flatness, boundedness or coefficient flatness is assumed; this statement does not assert invertibility of either scalar counit.

proof.text: Use balancing-chain uniqueness and B-linearity to lift the transported ordinary tensor comparison to B-module sheaves. Transposing through the scalar and geometric adjunctions identifies its inverse with the ordinary scalar mate: both unit formulas send x to 1 tensor inverse-image(x). Reuse its proved ordinary lifting and mate-identification helpers; these do not use the derived normalization theorem.

Apply the normalized cochain representative formula for the derived mate, then exact scalar restriction. Use the termwise restriction/pullback localization square. The beta factors and ordinary tensor identifications cancel to give the stated c_t square on every complex.

theorem scalarTensorChainCounitSquare
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (t : scalarMateOrdinaryTensor φ Y ⋙ proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f ≅
      proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f ⋙ scalarMateOrdinaryTensor φ X)
    (ht : IsScalarBalancing φ f t)
    (P : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y A)) ℤ) :
    (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f).map
      ((scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (scalarExtensionFunctorCounit φ Y P) ≫
        (scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          ((reductionChangeComplex Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)).obj P)) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        (((scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((reductionChangeComplex Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)).obj P)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (scalarTensorChainIso φ f t P).hom =
    (proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedPullback f
      (proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (proEtaleConstantRing Y B)
      (proEtaleConstantRing X A) (proEtaleConstantRing X B)
      (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ) (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := X) φ)
      (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f A) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f B)
      (proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap_naturality f
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.ulift φ))).symm).inv.app
          ((directImageScalarExtension φ Y).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
      (scalarMateRestriction φ X).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((directImageScalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (directImageScalarExtension φ X).map
            ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
          scalarExtensionFunctorCounit φ X
            (((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
      (scalarMateRestriction φ X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        ((reductionChangeComplex X (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := X) φ)).obj
          (((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
